key.name: enabled
key.description: Enable or disable the tiling window manager

key.name: single-gap-top
key.summary: Top gap around a single window
key.description: Gap between a single tiled window and the top screen edge (0 = no gap)

key.name: single-gap-bottom
key.summary: Bottom gap around a single window
key.description: Gap between a single tiled window and the bottom screen edge (0 = no gap)

key.name: single-gap-left
key.summary: Left gap around a single window
key.description: Gap between a single tiled window and the left screen edge (0 = no gap)

key.name: single-gap-right
key.summary: Right gap around a single window
key.description: Gap between a single tiled window and the right screen edge (0 = no gap)

key.name: layout
key.description: dwindle, master-stack, or centered-master-stack

key.name: dwindle-ratio
key.description: Ratio for dwindle splits (0.3 to 0.7). Default 0.618 is the golden ratio (1/φ)

key.name: master-ratio
key.description: Ratio of the screen allocated to the master window (0.15 to 0.85)

key.name: borders-enabled
key.description: When disabled, no borders are drawn around windows (rounded corners still apply if enabled)

key.name: active-border-width
key.description: Thickness of the active window border in pixels

key.name: active-border-color
key.description: Color of the active window border as hex string

key.name: active-border-color-2
key.description: Second color of the active window border gradient as hex string

key.name: inactive-border-width
key.description: Thickness of inactive window borders in pixels

key.name: inactive-border-color
key.description: Color of inactive window borders as hex string

key.name: inactive-border-color-2
key.description: Second color of the inactive window border gradient as hex string

key.name: border-radius
key.description: Radius of border corners in pixels (0 for square corners)

key.name: rounded-corners
key.description: When enabled, window content corners are masked to match the border corner radius

key.name: window-blur
key.description: When enabled, the content behind windows is blurred

key.name: window-blur-radius
key.description: Strength of the window blur in pixels

key.name: window-blur-brightness
key.description: Brightness of the blurred layer (1.0 leaves it unchanged)

key.name: window-blur-opacity
key.description: Opacity of window content over the blurred layer (100 is fully opaque)

key.name: gradient-borders
key.description: When enabled, window borders use a gradient between the two border colors instead of a single color

key.name: gradient-direction
key.description: Direction of the border gradient: vertical, horizontal, or diagonal

key.name: border-animation-speed
key.description: Speed of the gradient border rotation (0 = off, 10 = fastest)

key.name: debug
key.description: Log per-event debug details (window removal, grab operations) to the journal

key.name: float-windows
key.summary: Window class instances that should float
key.description: Lowercase WM_CLASS instance names that should not be tiled

key.name: float-titles
key.description: Exact window titles that should not be tiled (case-sensitive)

key.name: resize-amount
key.description: Number of pixels to resize per keypress

key.name: center-window
key.description: Float and center the focused window on the monitor

key.name: follow-focus
key.description: When true, the mouse cursor warps to the center of the focused window on keybind navigation and new window creation, but not on mouse clicks

key.name: mouse-resize
key.description: When enabled, dragging window edges resizes the split ratio and dragging the title bar swaps windows

key.name: workspace-popup
key.description: Show a popup with the workspace number and its layout when switching workspaces

key.name: tiling-popup
key.description: Show a popup when tiling is toggled on or off

key.name: pick-mode
key.description: When true, the next window click is captured for float rule creation

key.name: pick-mode-class
key.description: WM_CLASS instance of the picked window

key.name: pick-mode-title
key.description: Window title of the picked window

key.name: pick-float-window
key.description: Press to enter pick mode; click a window to add it to the float list by class or title

key.name: cycle-layout
key.description: Cycle between dwindle, master-stack, and centered-master-stack

key.name: scratchpad-toggle
key.description: Show or hide all scratchpad windows on the current workspace

key.name: scratchpad-add
key.description: Hide the focused window and store it in the scratchpad

key.name: scratchpad-remove
key.description: Restore the focused scratchpad window to its original workspace and position

key.name: dropdown-terminal-command
key.description: Command used to launch the drop-down terminal. The drop-down terminal keybind toggles this terminal on and off.

key.name: dropdown-terminal-height
key.description: Height of the drop-down terminal as a percentage of the screen height

key.name: dropdown-terminal
key.description: Show or hide the drop-down terminal on the active monitor

key.name: background-app-enabled
key.description: Pin the configured app behind all windows as a live desktop background

key.name: background-app
key.description: Command for an app pinned behind all windows as a live desktop background (looks best with frameless windows). Empty disables.

key.name: scratchpad-border-color
key.description: Border color for scratchpad windows so the scratch layer is visually distinct, e.g. ['#f5c211']
